fato_historico: 1976: The Tangshan earthquake measuring between 7.8 and 8.2 moment magnitude flattens Tangshan in the People's Republic of China, killing 242,769 and injuring 164,851.
energia_do_dia: Today brings a profound reminder that even after the most challenging earth-shaking transitions, life finds a way to rebuild and bloom again. Much like a resilient structure rising from the dust, you may feel an urge to fortify your spirit. It is a good time to acknowledge your hidden depth and honor the endurance within your heart.
frase_do_dia: Deep roots allow you to weather any storm and rise with new grace.
significado_numero: Represents the power of renewal and building foundations from the past.
conselho: Consider letting go of old structures to make room for your beautiful transformation.
